database: Current release base: Atlas schema 6 across sixteen domains; additive media schema 7; FileStore abstraction and SQLite compatibility retained
architecture: File bodies are encrypted on clients before S3 upload; the current v2 message relay can read reference keys and is not E2EE against the relay
Private S3, existing presigned single/multipart APIs and FileStore metadata retained
Filename, MIME, dimensions and duration follow the existing message payload security model
No server-side media decoding, transcoding or claim of malware scanning encrypted files
No production deployment, bucket mutation or rewrite of existing media
retained: AES-GCM legacy and chunked wire formats
Multipart size/checksum-bound presigning and completion verification
Member-only expiring downloads and range requests
Web encrypted IndexedDB checkpoints and sealed file keys
Android URI streaming, photo picker, camera, Media3 playback and optional on-device compression
Existing Free/Plus and community Spark entitlements; legacy Go reader only
Albums, captions, viewers, local media gallery and retention jobs

checklist.issue: Completion misses canPost and changed plan checks; multipart finalization cannot recover if S3 completed before metadata write
checklist.result: Completion rechecks membership, posting/attachment rights and current entitlements; persisted completion manifests and assembled-object recovery are tested

checklist.issue: Network fallback aborts multipart progress; workers can continue after sibling failure; single PUT expiration and cancellation need fixes
checklist.result: Retains multipart progress after transient failures, settles sibling workers, refreshes authorization and honors cancellation

checklist.issue: Small uploads ignore cancellation; async checkpoint persistence race; empty and mismatched Blob sizes accepted
checklist.result: Small and large files use persisted encrypted checkpoints, serialized writes and stable message IDs; empty/size mismatch checks added

checklist.issue: Automatic WebP rewrite and download conversion remove original fidelity; explicit quality controls missing
checklist.result: Original is default; original downloads retain exact bytes; explicit optimization and animation/alpha guards added

checklist.issue: No photo/video previews, dedicated pickers or camera entries; selection truncates silently
checklist.result: Dedicated photo/video/camera selectors, bounded previews, filenames/sizes and clear selection errors; mobile captions verified visible

checklist.issue: File card lacks progress/cancel; resumed ranges not validated; unbounded shared plaintext cache
checklist.result: Progress/cancel/retry, validated ranges and byte limits, bounded per-engine cache and account-scoped proxy fallback

checklist.issue: No zoom; unsupported codec playback has no actionable error; Safari fullscreen fallback missing
checklist.result: Web zoom/pinch/pan, native bounded drawable decoding, decoder errors and Safari fullscreen fallback implemented; physical device checks remain

checklist.issue: Local loaded-message index only; no separate video tab or filename search/context action
checklist.result: Preserved concurrent native paginated collections and existing Web pages; both now offer photo/video and filename filters within the visible page, with thumbnail loading and original-message context actions

checklist.issue: Cancellation leaves direct upload until TTL; animated WebP/AVIF can be flattened; default photo compression; legacy ciphertext ceiling does not subtract GCM tag
checklist.result: Native network cancellation, durable ciphertext/session/manifest checkpoints, conservative animation preservation and legacy GCM limit corrected

checklist.issue: Cross-platform encrypted derivative protocol and persisted paginated attachment index require design and implementation
checklist.result: Additive encrypted thumbnail descriptors generated/read/retained by both clients; current release collection APIs retained; no extra media database/provider

checklist.issue: Run deterministic S3/API, Web crypto/upload/browser, Android JVM/build; real devices and paid staging unavailable unless discovered
checklist.result: Backend, Web unit/integration/browser, native JVM and build checks run; physical device, staging S3, near-1 GB transfers and load/operations certification remain

checklist.issue: Server/client maxima used inconsistent decimal/binary units above the requested absolute 1 GB ceiling
checklist.result: New uploads and admin bounds cap at exactly 1,000,000,000 plaintext bytes; lower configured entitlements remain effective; encryption overhead is separate and legacy larger originals remain downloadable
